messages:
Samir Patel: morning handoff — short summary: embeddings GPU pool (emb-gpu-pool-us-east) had a driver crash and node reboot loop starting ~06:06 UTC. Some customers saw 503s for embedding requests. We hit routing fallback to cpu-embeddings and a small dedicated backup pool. Impact window ~06:06–06:20, some residual elevated latency until now.

incident-bot: Pager: EMBED_POOL_DEGRADED triggered at 06:07 UTC — 4 p50 lat spikes, 6% 5xx on /v1/embeddings in us-east-1.

Leah Torres: oncall notes — i'm taking primary for the next 8h. Jon will be secondary. Samir, did we already pin traffic away from the affected nodes?

Samir Patel: yes — live routing policy switched to `cpu-embeddings-v2` and `emb-backup-small` at 06:09 via autoscaler-bypass. Added a short 5m route weight to avoid cold-start thundering.

Maya Chen: logs show `nvidia: GPU hung, resetting` followed by `kernel: oops` on 3 nodes. Kernel patch candidate: kernel-5.15.0-rt1 is available but requires rolling reboot.

Jon Rivera: customer impact list we surfaced:
- AcmeAnalytics (low-volume batch jobs) saw ~12% failed embeddings from 06:07–06:19 (retries succeeded)
- NotableApps (customer-facing synth search) experienced increased first-query latency ~1.2s additional for 06:07–06:15
- Internal QA had some failures but no major loss

Priya Kaur: I pinged account reps for AcmeAnalytics and NotableApps at 06:25, asked for logs, SLA note. Heads-up message drafted here: `We're investigating intermittent embedding errors in us-east; traffic has been routed to backup pools; we expect no data loss.`

Samir Patel: mitigation performed:
- Drained 3 nodes from emb-gpu-pool-us-east
- Enabled fallback routing (verified with `curl` smoke)
- Scaled up `emb-backup-small` by +2 replicas (kubectl snippet below)
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy emb-backup-small --replicas=5
kubectl -n inference cordon gpu-node-27 gpu-node-31 gpu-node-42
```

Maya Chen: currently collecting kernel oops stacks, filters show same call path. We think a vendor driver edge-case caused the hung state. Plan: patch to kernel-5.15.0-rt1 and restart nodes during low-traffic window.

Leah Torres: immediate next steps (today):
1) Samir/Maya — prepare safe rolling reboot playbook and test on staging (in 30m).
2) Jon — monitor for leftover 5xx or latency, reduce route weight to backup if errors spike.
3) Priya — follow up with customers and escalate if they want an incident RCA.
4) Ops-runbook-bot — pin runbook links in thread.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook pinned — Embeddings GPU pool degradation: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-pool-degradation 
Checklist excerpt: `verify fallback routing -> cordon nodes -> collect /var/crash -> apply kernel patch -> reboot with rolling window`

Samir Patel: test plan for staging (quick):
- apply kernel-5.15.0-rt1 to one staging node
- run embed load @ 100 qps for 10m
- validate no hangs, check nvml logs
If green, schedule rolling reboot for prod in 2h (low traffic).

Maya Chen: temporary alert tuning: lowering sensitivity to avoid alert fatigue; will change EMBED_POOL_DEGRADED rule: require 3m sustained 5xx rate > 4% (was 1m). I will revert once patch completes.

Jon Rivera: current status — backup pool handling ~18% of embeddings traffic, p50 latency for embeddings is 210ms (was 160ms), p95 ~850ms (down from 1.8s during spike). No new 5xx in last 8m.

Leah Torres: coverage: I'll be primary until 14:00 UTC. Jon is secondary. Maya will lead kernel patching. Samir will coordinate rollout and rollback steps. Priya owns customer comms.

Samir Patel: action items i've logged:
- #1 prepare CL to patch node bootstrap image (samir/cluster-images) — due EOD
- #2 schedule rolling reboot (ops calendar) — tentative 08:30 UTC
- #3 add backfill capacity to `emb-backup-small` if traffic rises + monitor cost impact

Priya Kaur: customer outreach — AcmeAnalytics accepts interim mitigation; they want a postmortem and ETA for patch. NotableApps asked to be notified when patch is scheduled.

Leah Torres: anything blocking the reboot? last check: we need approval from infra change window. Samir, can you file the change ticket now?

Samir Patel: filing change ticket `CHG-2198` now, linking runbook + rollback plan. ETA for review 15m.

Maya Chen: collecting final crash dumps; pushing to `s3://redwood-ops/emb-crash-dumps/2145006789` and attaching to CHG-2198. Will post a short summary after staging test.

Jon Rivera: i'll keep alert routing on watch and call page if any regressions. I also set a temporary dashboard with `embed_pool_errors` and `fallback_routing_ratio`. Link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/EMBEDS/embeds-ops?from=now-1h

Samir Patel: ok — handing off. Leah, Jon, Maya, Priya — please ack and we'll do a quick sync 20m before the planned reboot.

Leah Torres: ack. :white_check_mark:

Jon Rivera: ack — monitoring ready. :eyes:

Maya Chen: ack — staging test queued.

Priya Kaur: ack — i'll keep customers updated.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to MONITORING at 06:40 UTC.

Samir Patel: summary for incoming shift: incident resolved-to-monitoring, fallback routing in place, rolling reboot planned pending CHG approval, primary: Leah, secondary: Jon, patch owner: Maya, comms: Priya. Next update after staging test or pre-reboot sync.
